newsitem.title: UK: Cargill prevails in thin sugar freight market.
newsitem.headline: Cargill prevails in thin sugar freight market.

text.p: Cargill dominated activity on the sugar freight market at the end of the week, fixing one earlier inquiry and quoting for two vessels for Latin American business, shipbrokers said on Friday.
It fixed 14,000 tonnes of sugar from Thailand or Indonesia to the Philippines for the end of December, they said. Details of the rate have yet to emerge.

Cargill also quoted for 27/28,000 tonnes from Punta Morales/Puerto Quetzal to US Gulf/Atlantic for 15 January/5 February and 3/3,300 tonnes in bags from Guayaquil to Haiti for prompt/early January shipment dates.
